notes.content: [h1]Hello![/h1][p]Double EXP for new players for 1 month! Read more about it in the devlog! :)[/p][p]I will continue to develop the game, most likely for a very long time. But I will take breaks, this is the 2nd update in a short time and this is a pretty big one. My guess is that the next update after this will be a christmas update where I might introduce new things and systems, who knows. There might be updates earlier but time will tell. Regardless, the game will continue getting updates, that is the point I'm trying to make. There will always be new things to challenge the players. Every suggestion and bug report is valuable as it helps improve the game. And that is what we all want, a fun, challenging game, and on top of that: a great adventure![/p][p]A reminder for those who do not know. There is a NPC below the first starting temple in the first town. Who offers a full stat and skill reset. You can do this once when you start. But you can also do it again after you reborn/seraph each time. It does not stack, but it allows you to play a different character an extra time. Each reborn/seraph already offers you to distribute the stats/skills freely, but you can then reset all that one time for each reborn/seraph, [/p][p]For those really high level, this update brings a total of 45 extra skill point slots that you can put your points into. Previously, a high seraph might not find more useful skills to put points into. But the new additions and buffs to existing skills will make the decision on what to put your points into more interesting and unique.[/p][p]This update also focuses on gold. Playing in a party gives more gold than before, monsters and events are created that further boosts gold. The most expensive upgrade has been made 20% cheaper. There will be more opportunities to become rich now.[/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights/Features[/h2][list][*][p]More than 100+ new items added and new monsters/maps added.[/p][/*][*][p]All new and current players that have not reborn yet and are below level 70 will have DOUBLE EXP for 1 month starting now. Ends August 12th.[/p][/*][*][p]New lategame rooms has been added. One of these is the most difficult room of all time and might not be possible to beat without an enourmous party/team. I know I have been proven wrong before, but I think this one will actually be difficult to deal with. Do not underestimate the boss this time or you may suffer the consequences. This monster drops a new sword, a new quiver and a new scepter.[/p][/*][*][p]Star Monsters with 5 stars has been implemented. This is the ultimate champion and the reward can be even stronger than that of the 4 star monsters. It is stronger in all categories but it also has the potential to offer better bonuses than 4 star monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]A new class has been added: An intelligence based Paladin. New weapons has been added for this class and they are available as drops and from shops.[/p][/*][*][p]Elite Gear is introduced for all current Prime items (armor sets). All monsters that currently drop Prime Gear can now also drop Elite Gear. This means that if the drop is triggered when the monster dies: There is a 70% chance of the item being a Prime, and 30% chance of the item becoming Elite. Elite Gear gives more AC and +1 upgrade level. An Elite part has the same requirement as the Prime part. The Elite drop will however not be visible in the monster drop list. But if the monster can drop for example Leater Helmet Prime, then it can also drop Leather Helmet Elite.[/p][/*][*][p]All Robes and Hats now have Prime and Elite drops. All monsters that currently drop normal robes and hats, now have a 30% chance of the gear being Prime, and I 20% chance of the gear being Elite. So 50% of the time the gear will be just normal.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 5 new top lists for most unique monsters killed, most monsters killed overall, most killed Gabons, Tjikos etc.[/p][/*][*][p]A new waypoint has been setup between island 5 town and island 6 bridge. A NPC has been added to the exit out of the town that offers to teleport you for 30.000gold.[/p][/*][*][p]A new Event System has been added. That introduces many new automatic events. The configuration has been set to start a few events each day for each server. The duration and boosts are randomized. Here are some of the available events:[/p][list][*][p]Gems: All monsters killed has a 25% chance to drop XGems![/p][/*][*][p]Unidentified: Boosts the chance for items to become Unidentified by XX%![/p][/*][*][p]BossGold: Boosts Gold dropped by all Bosses with XX%![/p][/*][*][p]CaveGold: Boosts Gold dropped by all Monsters on darker maps with XX%![/p][/*][*][p]Colosseum: Boosts EXP by XX% in all Colosseums![/p][/*][*][p]BossPets: All bosses has a XX% chance to drop a random pet.[/p][/*][*][p]MagicChests: Gives all chests a XX% chance to drop an Event Potion![/p][/*][*][p]Resilience: All players are boosted with +XX Resilience! Take the opportunity to fight something you previously was not able to handle.[/p][/*][*][p]MonsterGold: All Monsters now give XX% more gold![/p][/*][*][p]Tokens: All monsters killed has a XX% chance to drop a Token![/p][/*][*][p]And many more![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/389c6f987606f6ba7f05448ee33a07fcc34cb375.png"][/img][/p][h2]Skill Changes[/h2][list][*][p]The Untwine skill has received the following buffs: Reduces damage taken from bombs, traps and clouds by 4%/point. +4 Max Stamina per point instead of +2.[/p][/*][*][p]The skill Deathblock has been rebalanced: "When a fatal hit occurs, there's a +2% chance per point to fully block it and heal to 100% HP. Lose 2% less EXP on death per point. Heavily prevents your pet from loosing EXP on death. Also grants +8 Max Health per point." Max boosted value has been changed from 40 to 35.[/p][/*][*][p]The skill Gold Finder has been buffed and rebalanced: "Each point grants +2.5% chance to find bonus gold from monsters and increases the gold amount. At 5 points, you gain 5–10 extra gold. At 15points, you gain 15-30 gold. Bonus gold also forms a damage-absorbing shield (e.g. 10 gold = 10 damage absorbed). Gained gold stacks on the shield until enough hits and damage drains it. Resets on logout." The gold/shield gained is also shown on the screen so you know when you get extra gold/shield. In order to see the shield drained you need to check the damage indicator from the monster damage, it will show a smaller number when you have the shield compared to when you have no shield active.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot Finder has been buffed: "Each point increases your Chest Storage Capacity by 2 slots and +2 Max Stamina. Each point gives +1% item drop chance from monsters. For example, a 1-in-1000 drop becomes 1-in-900 with 10 points. Also boosts chance to get unique skills on +0 items by 1% per point."[/p][/*][*][p]The skill Gatherer has been buffed and rebalanced: "Each point gives +2.5% chance to gather more than one resource at a time from housing skills. Each point increases your Chest Storage Capacity by 1 slot. Protects the gatherer by providing 0.25AC/point."[/p][/*][*][p]The skill Snare has been buffed with the following effect: "Snare deals 2% of your damage/point, with minimum damage of your amount of points times 2.". So if you have 5 points in snare and 10% of your damage only adds up to 7 damage for example, then you would deal 10 damage instead thanks to the minimum check.[/p][/*][*][p]The skill Aura has been buffed: "+10 Max Mana per point.".[/p][/*][*][p]The skill Poison has been rebalanced to be percentage based: "Works with all attacks. Poison deals 2% total damage per point, with +1.5% trigger chance/point. Ticks 3 times. Non-lethal to players and monsters. Min damage: Points × 2.". Due to the minimum check, the skill is always at least equal to how it was before. But now it scales upwards with your damage and can become even stronger. The 20str requirement on poison has also been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]The skill Trueshot has been rebalanced so it's max boosted amount is now 35 instead of 30 and it's damage dealt is 65% instead of 60%.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now put 15 points into Trueshot instead of 10.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now put 20 points into Doublehit instead of 10.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now put 20 points into Deathblock instead of 15.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now put 20 points into Pet Power instead of 15.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now put 20 points into Poison instead of 15.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now put 20 points into Gatherer instead of 15.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now put 30 points into Replenishment instead of 20.[/p][/*][*][p]Some other minor changes are also made, check max boosted values from the ingame skills menu (in the top right corner) for example and read on all skills by hovering them on the skills menu (from a tab on the inventory menu).[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/c232d49e9aa425fa32d097a1138c28c3ae646d0b.png"][/img][/p][h2]Improvements/Additions/Balancing[/h2][list][*][p]You now get way more gold from monsters when being in party. Before you split the amount of gold the monsters dropped. But now all of you get 70% of the total amouont of gold the monster had. So if the monster had 1000gold, all the party members on the map would get 700gold each. Imagine you are 3 party members, previously you would each get 333gold each from a 1000gold monster, now you would each get 700gold.[/p][/*][*][p]The drop rate of charms has been changed from 7 in 2.000.000 to 7 in 500.000. Charms are not overpowered and do take up space in the inventory. So I think this is something that will be more utilized moving forward in updates. This +75% increase in drop should have happened way earlier. But they have been kinda forgotten since their creation more than 15+ years ago I think. It might be lowered further later on but let's start with this.[/p][/*][*][p]You now get between 15-30 Gems for each Battle Royale match you win![/p][/*][*][p]You now get between 5-10 Gems for each Match Making game you win![/p][/*][*][p]The ingame data list has been getting a lot more info. Especially when it comes to Prime and Elite gear.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss Event frequency has been increased from app 1 in 3 days to 1 in 2 days.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrading an item to +0 now costs 40.000gold instead of 50.000gold.[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled the amount of gold you get from monsters on Colosseum Island 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters cast Dispell and Debless less frequently.[/p][/*][*][p]The !events command you can type in the chat that displays running events has now been updated to include bossevents and the new eventsystem featureing 10+ events.[/p][/*][*][p]When logging in the game will no longer send a message for each of the events running. Instead now it will say: "There are active events running. Type !events in the chat for more info!" Since there are now so many different possible events and types of events.[/p][/*][*][p]The !clear command will now also clear the onscreen ingame chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Quivers has been slightly buffed.[/p][/*][*][p]Some other smaller items has received some small rebalancing.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the new global loot system from the last update to drop an item by the chance 1 in 2000 instead of 1 in 1000.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the gold some on the two new monsters from last update who had way to much gold and was nerfed.[/p][/*][*][p]All daily quest rewards has been buffed.[/p][/*][*][p]The point system Reputation has been further utilized in the late game.[/p][/*][*][p]The "daily click" to claim the Daily Reward has all been buffed with more rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Map 927 has been made a safezone, it's a very lategame map between some mountains that now offer you to access your storage chest.[/p][/*][*][p]Star monsters will now appear 25% more often. A monster spawning had a 1 in 100 chance before, now the chance is 1 in 75 of becomming a star monster. There are so many star monsters now, 1 to 5. So an increase felt needed to allow them to appear and affect the gameplay more.[/p][/*][*][p]Colosseum bosses give way more gold on island 5. They will now average between 500-2000gold/player on the colosseum map. If you are 4 players, you can each get 2000gold per boss if super lucky.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced some monster spawn times.[/p][/*][*][p]More guild rooms has been made available since they can run out if enough players claim them.[/p][/*][*][p]Items added to the player market before 2025-01-01 has been removed. There is now currently 334 items in the market.[/p][/*][*][p]The boss "Dead Charmer" now drops items more frequently.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/fa2a71a58cf192945847dfe4182142f7889fc4e5.png"][/img][/p][h2]Early Game[/h2][list][*][p]Some early game items like belts has been made free of requirements.[/p][/*][*][p]The starting chest that gives you leggings, now also gives you a wooden stick to fight with.[/p][/*][*][p]An extra new chest has been added to the starting tutorial to make it easier for new players.[/p][/*][*][p]Some new chests has been added to the first town to make it more fun for new players.[/p][/*][*][p]The Vanguard boss on island #1 has received 20% more EXP and has been made slightly easier.[/p][/*][*][p]A new shop has been added to the starting temple to help new players with cheap items.[/p][/*][*][p]Many more items has been added to the shops on island 1 to make it easier and more fun for new players.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/6c2af3e5288b2c6d7a2cf749e4d2add4b2e29635.png"][/img][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed top lists so it for example displays the top most found pets etc correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed server activity so that it will restore the functionality at least ones a day.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with monster arrows.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

All monsters can trigger this special item spawn. This means that all monsters in the game now has loot that you do not know about. And new players can get super lucky and get something that higher level players would want. When this item drops, it will say Special Drop on the screen so that you know you hit the jackpot.[/p][/*][*][p]The skill level system has been increased from max level 30 to max level 48![/p][/*][*][p]New maps, monsters and bosses added. All monsters can trigger this special item spawn. This means that all monsters in the game now has loot that you do not know about. And new players can get super lucky and get something that higher level players would want. When this item drops, it will say Special Drop on the screen so that you know you hit the jackpot.
The skill level system has been increased from max level 30 to max level 48!
New maps, monsters and bosses added. Especially on the lategame after the finale NPC.
More than 10+ new items has been added.
The item Break Prevention has been added to more monsters/bosses as a drop on island 5.
Star Monsters with 4stars has been implemented:
Guaranteed unidentified on all items dropped by the monster.
Better unique items that can only be gotten from x4 star monsters. Bonuses given from these monsters has the ability to be the highest if you are lucky. No other drop can give the same.
You can now equip 2 of the same ring. Before you where required to have 2 different rings equipped.
The base storage size in chests has been increased to 35 items. If you had purchased more storage before, then you get these extra 5 storage as well.
Lore Seeker Lenny on i5 has his name above him now so he is easier to find.
The player bonus "Reputation" is now further utilized.
Server activity from the development servers will also be shared in the server activity window.

tags.balance_change: Colosseum Event potions drop more frequently from all chests.
All Global Colosseum Event potions have been boosted: 15min +20%, 30min +30%, 60min +40%. This should help encourage players to team up and battle in the Colosseum.
They are tougher than 3 star-monsters.
More gold and experience.
Pets has been buffed when they cast entangle, they now also attack at the same time.
The skill level system has been adjusted. You now get only the real skills, you previously got farming,fishing skills and such.
Shops in the first town now offer much more items for sale.
Shops on island 2 has also been improved.
Most spell durations have been increased so you do not need to buff yourself as often.
Some items that gave poor stats has been changed to give proper boosts, example shadow cape +2farming changed to +2critical hit.
Many pets has been buffed.
The monster abilities Bombs and Clouds now deal less damage.
Exp on many monsters on island 1 has been increased. Especially in the Castle and caves.
Exp on some monsters on island 2 has been increased. Especially in the Castle.
Exp on some monsters on island 3 has been increased.
All servers has been set to reboot once a week.
Some skinnable items has been made cheaper from the skin NPC (can be found in the first town in the very south middle house).
Snakerzor: Rebalanced with exp and damange, and the drop rate of pets has been increased so it's easier to get.
The Gabon, Watermask and Ghostling monsters has been given reduced spawn time, its now only 10min for each.
The chance was intially developed to be smaller for star bosses to appear on boss events. But it is now the same chance all over the place (meaning more star bosses on boss events).
Island 5 Colosseum has been buffed with more exp given from monsters.
All Colosseum bosses has been given more exp on all islands.
Colosseum monster minimum damage has been changed from 1 to random between 1-3.
The Colosseum on island 1-4 can now drop Global Colosseum Tier 1 Event potions.

tags.bug: Fixed skinning of items that required Gems. All those skins now work.
Fixed an item dupe issue.
Fixed gfx issue with Eternal Morningstar and possibly some other items as well.
Fixed/Improved loot finder. It helps more now to get unidentified items.
Fixed so if you have no volume on when playing the finale chapter video. It now plays with audio anyway so that you know you are not missing the lore!
Fixed issue where TNL did not show all your exp if you where very high level.
Fixed the written chat commands. Write !help in game to get a list of them.

notes.title: Dev Log #28: Surge
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
* The NPC who resets your stats and skill points will now offer a reset everytime you reborn. So if you use it and then reborn, you will get it back. Skipping to reset and seraphing will not give you an additional one next time. It's always max 1 and then you need to reborn to get it back.
* Assassins will now be able to wear a shield together with their throwing stars. The shield will not be shown on the attack animation as the assassin puts it aside when throwing.
* Global Colosseum Event potions added to the game. Currently only available to get from chests (all ingame chest has chance to give them) and a few monsters. This boost also works together with normal exp potions and global exp events, so they all stack. There are 3 tiers:
[list][*] Tier 1: Duration 15minutes +10%EXP in Colosseum.
[*] Tier 2: Duration 30minutes +20%EXP in Colosseum.
[*] Tier 3: Duration 60minutes +30%EXP in Colosseum.
[/list]
* Two new bosses has been added. There was previously 2 monsters on the monster in game list that did not exist. Now they do (found on on all islands).
* A new area has been added on i6 below the Frosty Meadowdeller, with a new boss.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/b952f5100ded8615e11495c9b23074de10de4c72.png[/img]
[b]Improvements[/b]
* New setting added to the petbook menu. You can now disable showing the evolution, doing so will show the first evolution of the pet only (the one after the egg is hatched).
* You can no longer trash gold.
* Replaced multishot skill on 2 bows to other skills. Because some players dont like to have multishot.
* Monster Everdale now has incerased drop rate on quest items.
* Pet exp bar will be hidden by default, and only show when the pet has gained some exp and then show for 3 sec. So if the pet is always attacking it will always be shown. But when he goes out of combat the bar will hide.
* You can now identify items on island 3 town.
* You can now click on the text on the Server Select page that says "Want to host a Server? Check Steam Tools or click here!" to navigate to more info.
* Island 4 spawn point and identify has info marker so you easier find them.
* The text below the language select telling you, you can help with languages, now navigates you to the community upon clicked.
* The music player handling sound effects and background music now supports decimal volumes. So you can put it at the right spot that suits you.
* Caves and areas to explore on island 1,2,3 has been given a few more bosses so going down caves is more profitable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/2e5fe76d555b90971bc592a6c356da583b1e38d7.png[/img]
[b]Balancing[/b]
* If you are x2 or above, you can now walk past the i3 castle towards the harbour and sail to i4 immedietly. This means that if you are x2 or above, it will no longer require level 50 to reach island 4. You can also travel by ship to i4 if you are above level 35 and above or equal to x2.
* Monsters on island 6 can now drop quest items from the island 5 area, to make it easier to spawn the bosses that require those items.
* Automatic systems that can jail a player for what appears to be wrongfull behaviour has been made more lenient.
* Info regarding the 3 server changes below: Your character can jump between the servers. So if you create your character on EU, you can at any time login to the US with the same character.
* Exp on the official servers has been permanently increased accordingly (this is an overall 10% buff):
[list][*] 	EU Server (PVP): From 1.1 to 1.2
[*] 	US Server (PVE): From 1.0 to 1.1
[/list]
* Gold on the official servers has been permanently increased accordingly (this is an overall 10-20% buff):
[list][*] 	EU Server (PVP): From 1.0 to 1.2
[*] 	US Server (PVE): From 1.0 to 1.1
[/list]
* Loot on the official servers has been permanently increased accordingly (this is an overall 10-20% buff):
[list][*] 	EU Server (PVP): From 1.0 to 1.2
[*] 	US Server (PVE): From 1.0 to 1.1
[/list]
* Entity Plasma has been made easier to get on island 5.

[b]Fixes[/b]
* Fixed the experience gain craft (costs 10tokens and 1 emerald). It now gives what the description says.
* Fixed so armor penetration shows the correct value when proc. It only showed half the actual damage increase it actually did. So if the monster has 10AC, the AC is ignored and added to your damage. It previously showed 10dmg, but the change is actually 20 in that case so now it will show 20.
* Both servers now run on the same server time in UTC. So weekend events will line up in sync. Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) is the primary time standard globally used to regulate clocks and time. The game client shows the weekend events based on the client clock, so you will need to manually convert your time to UTC to know exactly when the weekend event starts. As they start when the clock enters a new day on for example saturday.
* Fixed monster 'The Gabon' drop issue.
* Fixed mapping issues on map 846.
* Monsters not killable has been removed from the monster list (the place you see what monsters you have killed).

[b]Performance[/b]
* The map with the reaper boss will no longer be laggy.
* The chat window will now clear older messages to avoid lag.
* Optimized startup so it's no longer handling the release timer countdown.

notes.title: Dev Log #27: Livability
notes.content:
[b]Features/Additions[/b]
* Exp boost extended to 2025-03-31. (All new/old characters that has not reborn (are mortal/x0) will have exp boost x2 until level 70! All characters that are or will be x1 seraph, will always have 50% more exp until level 70! Characters at or above x2 reborn/seraph, will not have any boost)
* Added a waypoint from island 5 town (near the entrance to the giant forest), costs 5k gold and teleports you to the bridge.
* Added the item 'Token' to be a global drop: 1 in 1000 monsters killed.
* Added a potion shop to island 5 ocean (potions are more expensive here).
* You can now connect to a server based on IP. So dedicated servers hosted by other players can be set to hidden. And you can now join that server by IP and play with your friends or just in secret if you so wish. The game now has a full dedicated server implementation with vast scripting potential.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/aaaab3513faf8939945a3ba34fc566aba1031fd8.png[/img]
[b]Improvements[/b]
* The split arrows from Multishot now deals 75% damage instead of 25%.
* The split arrows from multishot will not trigger and use up your archer abilities.
* Registering to a battle royale match now posts to server activity in the discord.
* Rare loot (+0) will no longer be able to give the following buffs: farming, fishing, mining, wood cutting, cooking.
* A weapon that becomes rare loot (+0) will no longer be able to give the skill gatherer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/0a5034532782302470bc02d728b7b7f72cec6149.png[/img]
[b]Balancing[/b]
* Increased chance for item upgrades to succeed. Changed from 50% chance of succeeding to 75% chance of succeeding. (So now a 25% chance of fail/break).
* Island 5 quest item drops increased a lot. It's now much easier to gather the requirements for Primeval Ember, Primeval Horn and Primeval Peridot. Done to increase encouragement to spawn the unique bosses and make it easier to do the quest and still chose to reborn afterwards.
* Travelling by the ship to i2 and i3 now requires less level for seraphs (reborn players). For each reborn it requires 5 less levels to a maximum of 15 levels lower requirement. This means a x3 player can get to i2 on level 5 and i3 on level 20.
* Lowered requirement from level 100 to 85 for the passage east on island 6.
* Islang 5 magical chest scroll is now much easier to get.
* Lowered the price of many items in island 5 shops.
* Wood cutting axe now gives +1 replenishment instead of +2 mining.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/ab4c8adaf2b13ce09425a01b98f16c6d12f129b8.png[/img]
[b]Fixes/Performance[/b]
* Fixed issue where upgrading an item didn't actually set the rarity level. So the correct color effect was not shown nor did it show the correct name for the rarity.
* Fixed archer and warrior abilities (shimmering, lightning etc..). They did much less damage than they where supposed to.
* The visual glitch with last 2 player improvement crafts. (You had to close and reopen the crafting menu to trigger the refresh before.)
* Fixed 'quest 4' text saying you get 2 skill points when you actually get 1.
* Heavily improved the information given to user to help resolve graphic issues.
* Improved error issue where you have problems with graphic drivers.
* Fixed party exp issue.
* Implemented a new packet safety system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/83e423a2e3582e3048c8d6cc44cd8be6275417a1.png[/img]

notes.title: Less than 10 days to the Finale!
notes.content:
The 29th of November the full game will be released and everybody will start from level 1 !
Here are some of the latest changes that can currently be tried out on the test servers.

[b]Features[/b]
* The 8 new animal monsters have been distributed to the world, each of them drop a unique pet.
* 3 new normal quests added, this means that all normal quests are now complete.
* The Castle of no Return quest has been completed.
* Added the final new body color.

* Max pet attacks before it gets exhausted and requires a map transition changed from 500 attacks to 600 attacks.
* Minimap is not visible when on the guildmap.
* Some walking NPCs has gotten new names.
* Boss events now have a level range to enter them for each island. More info in the flag menu in game. To prevent high level clearing the low level areas.
* Buffed some of the global exp event potions (all players share the boost) from the steam payment shop without increasing the cost.

Fixes
* Fixed weekend events text info.
* Fixed a quest that was marked wrongly (obelix/finale).
* Fixed so you can not attack a friendly NPC when standing directly on top of him.
* Fixed some crafting requirements.
* Fixed some texts stuttering left and right.
* Fixed spectator attack issue.
* Fixed some texts on steam payments that did not show up.
* Fixed Laernan quest so it says the correct name.
* Fixed multiple death issue.

notes.title: Final Release: 29th of November 2024!
notes.content: On the [b]29th of November 2024[/b] the game will [b]leave Early Access on Steam[/b] and become an officially finished and release game. Everybody will start from level 1! But, there will be more updates coming of course. But this will be the time to join and experience the first full official launch with no future wipe. All current characters that exist will be transferred to a Legacy server, where you can still enjoy them. But they can not participate on the new servers. Until this release, the servers will be offline, but a new update will be coming to the game that will show the countdown to launch. Learn more here: [url=https://key2heaven.com/]Game Website[/url] Join the community: [url=https://discord.gg/TmHHJkG]Discord[/url] [b]Download the game now and await the opening![/b] [b]Highlights[/b] * Two new servers have been set up for a new Realm, which will be the official one. These new servers start fresh, with everyone beginning at level 1. A Legacy Realm has also been established, meaning all old/current characters will exist there. You can enjoy your old character(s) on the Legacy server or join the adventures on the new official servers. * Guild Houses added: You can purchase one guild house if you are in a guild. The guild house is then accessible to all your guild members. The guild house can be leveled up by completing tasks from within it. This is shared progression for the entire guild. When the guild house levels up, it can receive new graphics (as it builds up) or offer new features, such as special buffs, shops, chests, etc. All guild houses will also link to a guild PvP map, allowing guilds to enter combat against other guilds from their own safe guild map. Other guilds cannot enter your guild map. The current max level for the guild house is 20. * A new visual map overview system has been added. It tracks which maps you have visited, how many maps you have found in the game, and provides a percentage of total discovery. You can also write a note for each map to better keep track of them. It also shows which map you are currently on and what you have left to discover. * All server now support endless reborn (seraph). It's optional and if done it means you start back on level 1 but with more stat and skill points each time. After each reborn the next reborn requires +10 levels. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/10469dc7f2f394d1669a2fd93c49f9665d142aa3.png[/img] [b]Features[/b] * A 'Boss Event' system has been added. All islands has their own map for the event with an entrance from each town to it. Which bosses that spawns are random so each event will be unique. The event duration is random, but around 45-60min. Entering for example the event on island 4, does not mean that you can not enter it on island 3 as well. The event is scheduled to run randomly with a frequency that should result in about 1 event per server every 5 days. The event is server specific, so it can happen on different servers at different times. It can also be started by the admin. When all bosses are killed on an islands event a reward is granted to the players on the map. Be carefull entering the island 5 event alone! * Island 5 has been restructured to be more linear, similar to the other islands. For example, you now need to traverse the forest on the left side before reaching the bridge that leads towards the ocean. * New maps have been added to the continuation of island 5 and 6. * A new "Skill Level" system has been implemented that boosts all skills. It is currently leveled up by obtaining rare loot in chests (other methods of obtaining it may be introduced in the future). This aims to make chests more interesting and motivate players to explore more. More information can be found in the flag menu in the game. * Other players are now rendered in red and your party members in green on the minimap, making it easier to locate them. * The random daily quest that previously required specific monsters or bosses to be killed has been changed to any monsters or any bosses instead, allowing all players, regardless of level, to complete the quests. * Three new monster abilities have been added: Cloud, Shield, and Enrage. Cloud will spawn different types of "clouds" that cause continuous damage if you are within them. Shield will turn the monster a bluish color and provide extra defense for a period of time; the percentage of defense is shown when the monster casts it. Enrage (which should not be confused with an earlier disabled system) turns the monster red and increases its damage and movement speed for a period of time. If a monster is both enraged and shielded, it will turn green. * Many new types of spells/abilities added for these types of characters: archer/warrior/assassin/paladin, for example: Exploding Arrows (arrow deal great aoe damage), Lightning Arrows (arrow deal lightning damage that hops), Arrow Stun (arrow stuns a large area upon hit), Earthshaker (warrior: stuns nearby monsters), Seismic Slam (warrior: big aoe damage that ripples), and more! All can be bought from different towns by vendors. These are all new attack effects that will help make the gameplay more engaging and fun. More info exist in the flag icon menu above the chat window. * A new Discord channel called "Server-Events" has been added. Activity from the game will automatically be posted in that channel, including global and market chat, in-game events, player join events, deaths, level-ups (without specifying the new level), and more. Events from the Legacy server will not be posted. * Two new raft upgrades have been added through crafting. * The Adventurous quest has been continued with additional steps. * More secret stashes have been added, offering small rewards and boosting your total quest points. * Four new hairstyle choices have been added to the character creation menu. * Two new player improvement crafts have been added. * Many more in-game translations (localizations) have been added: Greek, Ukrainian, Indonesian, Polish, Thai, Vietnamese, Bulgarian, Russian, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, and Swedish. This aims to attract more players. * Winning either a Battle Royale match, or a match from the Match Making system will grant the winner some Gems. Just a little something to encourage players to fight more using those inbuilt systems. * Most buff spells now have a duration of at least 10minutes. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/cd7810a4663713a7c071fb8945f6ca01ae439bd0.png[/img] [b]Balancing[/b] * Increased starting chest storage capacity from 20 to 30 since its now account based. * Increased damage for star-level monsters and bosses. * Changed max monster damage that can be done to a player. Previous max was 45% of your total health in damage, new max monster damage is 35% of your total health. * Nerfed radicalheal from +2hp/point to +1hp/point. * Lowered max skill ceiling for radical heal, allround, lootfinder and goldfinder to 30. * Lowered chance for monsters to cast dispel from 1 in 200 to 1 in 300. * Taunt stamina requirement changed from 7 to 9. * Rebalanced items that gave too much skill points. * Increased gold gain from colosseums. * Lowered chance for +0 (unique) item drops from monsters, but increased chance from star monsters. * Bosses has been rebalanced to offer better party play (drop rates, difficulty etc..). * Raids have been turned more party oriented requiring at least 1 room to be fully cleared of monsters before proceeding. * Added a new system to help low endurance character builds. Reduces monster damage by a percentage based on the difference between damage and AC for up to 25% reduction. So if you have 5AC and monster has 100 damage, you previously took 95 damage. Now in that scenario you would take 71 damage. * Adjusted some crafts such as boosting the craftable mining axe and fishing rod. * Rebalanced monster experience on all islands, it has been increased a little on areas that are under utilized. * The automatic "Friday/Saturday/Sunday" events have been boosted from "15% Exp/15% Gold/+3 Gatherer skill" to "25% Exp/25% Gold/+5Gatherer skill". * Bombs dropped by monsters previously did "monsterDmg*0.8" in damage, now they deal "monsterDmg*1.5", so a big increase in damage output. * Splash skill has been changed from dealing 65% of your damage to nearby enemies to 50% of your damage. It now allows the player to put 15 points into it instead of 10 points and the max boosted cap has been changed from 40 to 35. Now there are new abilities for warriors to learn that stuns and splashes so the skill splash required some small adjustment. * Max boosted values for poison has been changed from 40 to 30 and chance of proc has been changed from 2% to 1.5% per point. * Buff-spells requirements and duration rebalanced. Focusing on allowing all characters to get some buff spells if they are interesting in investing some points into wisdom/intelligence. * Melee weapons (swords) and ranged weapons (bows) are evenly balanced. They now require the same amount of total statpoints and both deal the same weapon damage for each tier. Archer can attack from afar and warrior gets slightly more damage per stat points in strength. * Mana potions have been heavly buffed so they give you much more mana. For example the first mana potion has been changed from 20 to 50 mana per potion. So at least 100% increase on all mana potions. * When using a mana potion, you mana regeneration will increase by +5 mana regen for 5 minutes. Using another mana potion before the previous time has elapsed will simply reset it to 5 minutes again. This effect is the same for any mana potion used. Even a critical mana potion will give the same boost. * Stamina potions have been buffed so that they give you more stamina. * Rebalanced 5 different skills so their requirements are not below the starting stats in the game and more proper. * Max skill points that can be put into parry has been changed from 25 to 20. But Radicalheal can now proc at the same time as a parry. [b]Fixes[/b] * A major rework has been done of graphic textures to fix crashes on certain old and new computers with specific graphic configurations. * Fixed if monster exist on map and Pet Kill the last monster with pet attack the blocking boxes would not disappear. * Fixed so the Aura skill now displays the proper info for it. * Fixed issue where counterattack skill could not be disabled. * Fixed so the single target spell area turns black if the cast path is not valid. * Fixed issue where the bonus damage/percentage damage/percentage defence was always active on your character as long as you had an item that gave those boosts in your inventory. They will now only be applied to your character if the item is equipped or if it's on a charm. * Fixed so raft now renders in the correct direction. * Fixed newly introduced issues from last update: OnScreen chat, Spell info text and Player/Pet name moving while walking. * Fixed the bonus text in the inventory from changing color if you previously hovered a unique item. * Fixed so that main menu music stays disabled if the mute button was pressed. * Fixed issue where the previous monster damage ceiling should have been 45%, but that code had an issue so the system was not active before. * Fixed spellbar positioning issue that could result it not aligned at the bottom middle. * Fixed so trees are fully displayed when walking west direction and the tree leaves the map. * Fixed account login issue, rewritten to prevent the same account from being able to be logged in on different servers at the same time. * Fixed a text label that overlapped all tabs on the payment menu. * Fixed movement speed issue on older machines. * Fixed speelcooldown sometimes showing 1 second left on timer, but it was actually finished and ready to be cast. * Fixed so trueshot skill can no longer proc if there is a blocked tile between you and the monster. To prevent players from using it through walls. * Fixed all crafting receips from being broken (caused by the previous update). [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/79c7e4c46e0f04ea3da8a505964eaddfac473454.png[/img] [b]Improvements/Other[/b] * Monsters killed are now account based. So if you make a new 2nd character, your monster killed list will still be populated. * Player improvement crafts are now account based. So if you craft all the improvements on 1 character, all your other characters (new or old) can craft the same improvements for free. * Information text that was previously rendered on the screen directly. Is now replaced with a "?" symbol so that you can hover to read it instead. * Your storage chest is now shared between all the characters on your account. * Your information about Pets found is now shared across your account. * After traveling to castle of no return one time, you no longer need to enter the combination again. * After entering the long secret code on island 5, you no longer need to enter that combination again. * Swords and other weapon graphics have been made larger and improved. * It now says how many slots from your storage chest you have, ie: 6/30. * Now showing item and monster graphics on the in game data list. * Added more useful random conversations to the NPCs in the fifth town. * The new monster abilities have been provided to bosses across the world. * Colosseum bosses can wield the 3 new monster abilities. * A new background image added for the login screen. * No longer showing total created characters on server selection page. * Can now fish all around island 4 town. * Increased sight when rendering trees when walking up and down so they appear dissapear more clearly. * The ingame Data list on the flag menu has much more info added to the "Formulas tab". * The website now has a new top list for the new Realm, as well as a toplist for the Legacy server: https://www.key2heaven.com * Removed so items don't get cheaper over time in the player market. * Now showing a youtube video icon that brings you to a tutorial video from: character selection menu, ingame options->help page and the escape menu. It has also been added as a question for new players if they wish to see it. * New graphics added. * Speedrun toplist has been reset on the legacy server. * Now offers a FREE full stat and skill reset for your character(s) on the legacy server. Talk to the NPC near the starting temple! Available for new and old players. Players who previously had a unused reset available now has 1 extra reset. * Localizations have been updated. * New maps and map changes. * Lost Island now requires x1 seraph instead of x2 seraph. * The formulas tab is renamed to "Game Info". * Replaced the Facebook icon on the login page with a YouTube icon. * New setting added to the options menu to opt in or out from discord activity. The setting is saved per account. * The website top list has been improved so that you can sort the columns, and now showing top 100 instead of top 200: https://key2heaven.com/toplistv2.html * Improved error handling upon start up. * More monsters have been added. * Language list is now sorted alphabetically. * Lowered the transparency for casted spells so that they are more visible and clear. * New items and spells added. * The monster below i1 temple called "Check Damage", now has 500hp instead of 150hp. So you can easier check your damage output. * Removed the 'stat information' for characters on the 'create new character' screen and replaced it with an image for the new tutorial. (Since now all characters starts with 10 in all stats, previously you could distribute them). * Endless seraphing is implemented on all servers and that includes the legacy server. * There was previously two different reborn menus. Now we utilize the same window regardless if you reborn from i4 or i5. With some new info on it since its now endless seraphs. * Improved the backup randomizer for the game. * Some data for the legacy server is currently missing due to the change of many things being account based. But the data still exist, so a future update may bring it back. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/d9022a39156650eb2e7bc723fed0b1b2a3e61c74.png[/img] [b]Performance[/b] * Optimized networking performance for both client and server. * Implemented a safeguard incase client receives corrupt packets that should help prevent you from being disconnected. * Optimized layout rendering. * Optimized map transitions for the player. * Improved database query speed. * Optimized spellbar menu while its rendering its cooldown (to lower cpu usage). * Optimized graphical memory usage over time. * The servers now have dynamic dns to avoid IP issues. For more content, check the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@keytoheaven2dmmorpg567]YouTube[/url]!

notes.title: Dev Log #26: Homecoming!
notes.content:
We are back and the work will continue more quickly moving forward!

[b]Highlights[/b]
* Heavily improved rendering of graphics!
* A new spell is added: Homecoming. New players has it in their spellmenu by default. The spell will teleport you home to your spawnpoint with a cooldown of 30minutes. Old players will have to buy it in the shop area of island 1, in the town.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/444adeabeaa55d284b341f6acb3d00435d13ce00.png[/img]

[b]Improvements[/b]
* Now says the boss name as well when it shows how long time its left to spawn a boss on the map ypur are on.
* You can now search for player names in the open market.
* Maintenance reboot alert message will now appear for 300sec instead of 30sec.
* Pet eggs now move when walking.
* Start game loading time reduced.
* Text rendering improved.
* Music handler optimized to reduce lag.
* Graphics sharpness improved.
* Graphics rendering improved.

[b]Balancing[/b]
* Some lategame monster balancing (more gold etc..).
* Swapping a server now gives you 75% of the exp instead of 50% for 15minutes.

[b]Fixes[/b]
* Fixed text info on craft reset all stats and skill points.
* Fixed so it says the right exp boost on the party page, changed from 50% to 110% boost on the page.
* Implemented a potential fix for spell buffs dissapearing.

Make sure you try the Battle Royale game "inside the game", RPG style! Bring a friend or two and fight for the leaderboards! It does not require any leveling even though its inside a RPG, everybody starts with the same abilities. (This was included 2 dev logs ago!)

notes.title: Dev Log #25: New content and FIGHT!
notes.content:
So much is happening in the game right now. Make sure to join the discord channel for all the info and help from the community: [url=https://discord.gg/TmHHJkG]K2H Discord Channel[/url]

[b]Highlights:[/b]
* When entering a boss area, and the boss has already been killed. You will be notified how long time is left until it spawns.
* Party exp has been increased to 110% from 50%. It is very beneficial to play with friends since you all gain more exp the more players you are. 
Consider these scenarios where you attack a monster that gives 1000 EXP per hit:
	1 player (no party): You get 1000 EXP.
	2 players (in party): Each player gets 1050 EXP.
	3 players (in party): Each player gets 1067 EXP.
	4 players (in party): Each player gets 1075 EXP.
So each extra player adds a 10% extra from the monster EXP that the players share on each attack.
* Added the first quest for Island 6. Quests on Island 6 will not be included in the questbook.
* New maps, items and monsters added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/d9022a39156650eb2e7bc723fed0b1b2a3e61c74.png[/img]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
* You can now Reset all Stat and Skill points from the crafting menu. It's expensive.
* The summoning bosses north of island 5 town has been changed. The requirements are heavily reduced and the EXP gain is heavily increased. The hardest boss now gives 20M EXP.
* The max cap for all skills are now 3 times their normal max value with a maximum of 50. So if the skill allows 15 points in it, it then caps out at 45 with boosted points. When capped out, it will display in green text on the skill menu. You might think this is a nerf but it is extremely close to the previous hidden caps to prevent stuff from reaching 100% proc rate.
* Identifying an item now costs your level in gold. Was previously always 25gold.
* Colloseums can no longer spawn invisible monsters.
* There are now more cedar trees on island 5.
* In PvP, if the attacker is 20lvls higher than you, the attacker will deal 85% of its damage. If the attacker is 40lvls higher, the attackers damage becomes 70%.
* Rebalanced some bosses to spawn more frequent. A simple way of explaining the change is divide 'spawn time, max health and exp give' by 2, but with some variation. This results in the monster keeping the exp give per hit, but dies quicker but you can in return kill it again quicker.

* Added a !clear command that clears all the chats. Type !help in the chat for more info.
* Increased server security.
* Added support for more monsters into the game, since we have now reached more than 250 different monsters.

* Warrior leap spells have been buffed (there are two of them).
* Warrior Formation and Berserk spell has been slightly buffed.
* Splash now procs 2% of the time instead of 4.
* If a mage casts a spell that lands on multiple players. Then the first player will receive the full damage, and the other players in the target area will receive 25% of the damage.
* Slightly lowered wis/int dmg on some items.
* Bless spells now give more HP. Before they gav 1 HP per 6 Wisdom, now they give 1 HP per 3 Wisdom.
* Monsters now have 50% less chance to entangle.
* Monsters, items and spells have been slightly rebalanced.
* Trueshot has been buffed.
* It's now harder to get a unique item (with random boosted stats) when purchasing an item from a shop. To help prevent abuse.

* Fixed an issue related to targeting that could cause lag.
* Fixed blocked box griefing. Can no longer reset them by changing room.
* Fixed some monsters not showing as bosses.
* Fixed Impending morningstar attack speed and other stats.
* Fixed bonus stats displaying correct in the inventory stats tab.
* Fixed pet survival text in crafting menu.
* Fixed so charm droprate is actually what it said in the ingame data list. It was supposed to be "7 in 2m chance", but it was "7 in 2.5m chance" for drop. Meaning it's now easier to find charms.
* Overall bug fixes seen from the log files.
* Fixed issue with certain spells not displaying it's cooldown.
* Some map fixes.

notes.title: July 28th!
notes.content:
[h1]The update will be released on [b]July 28![/b][/h1]
The game will be updated before that, when that is done you will see a countdown timer on the server selection page so that you can be ready when it goes live. I will shortly put [b]all the servers into admin mode[/b], at that time you will not be able to play until the countdown finishes. 

[b]Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Content:[/b] Lots of new late-game areas added and new maps on all islands.
[*] [b]Stat Reset:[/b] There is a new NPC, on the starting map, that offers a one-time full stat+skill reset for all characters.
[*] [b]New Equipment Slot:[/b] A 2nd Ring Slot. You can now use 2 rings but they can not be the same.
[*] [b]Unidentified Items:[/b] Items you get with random bonus stats will now be unidentified by default. A new NPC is added to all towns where you can now identify an item for 25gold. The name of the new NPC is 'Lore Seeker Lenny'.
[*] [b]New Item Qualities:[/b] Common, Fine, Rare and Epic. The better quality the better and more boosts it has. Different item qualities will display different colored backgrounds in the inventory and the item bonus text.
[*] [b]Skinable items:[/b] There is a new NPC in each town that will allow you to skin your items. The cost will consist of either/and/or gold, emeralds, tokens, gems. The purpose is to allow for more late game customizations for your character, There is also another thing to consider. There are for example currently offhand items that do not have any visual graphics on your character. Such as quivers, scepters, orbs and so on. And those will now also be skinable!
[*] [b]60+ New Items:[/b] The current 10 different armor sets have now received an extra version of each called Prime. So for example you can find 'Leather Leggings Prime'. The prime gear will give extra bonuses while the normal set will just be basic. All prime gear is found from monster drops. 5 new weapons: A new weapon set has been added for all classes between Primordial and Impending.
[*] [b]30+ New Spells:[/b] Includes new spell types, icons and spell animations.
[*] [b]Weather Effects:[/b] Rain, Snow, Fog, Thunder, Sandstorm, Hail.
[*] [b]Monster Diversity:[/b] Monsters now have the ability to shoot arrows and drop bombs on the ground which you will want to avoid.
[*] [b]Communication:[/b] The global chat will post the chat message across all servers, so if you are on EU and write in global, players on the US server will see it.
[*] [b]New Players:[/b] All new characters start the game on x1 Seraph. There are currently 3 (optional) seraphs to be done, on each seraph you start back on level 1 but with more stat and skill points. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/79c7e4c46e0f04ea3da8a505964eaddfac473454.png[/img]

[b]Balancing / New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*]  All new created players starts with 10 stat points in each stat. You get 5stat points per level. Each seraph provides an additional 5 points in each stat. 
[*]  You can now hide behind blocked objects such as walls etc to avoid ranged enemies from attacking you. They will not see you so you can regroup and replan your next attack.
[*]  Seraph x1 requires level 60, each seraph after that requires +10 levels.
[*]  New tile type called a Box. Can be placed on a map and when all monsters on the map is killed, the boxes will dissapear to allow passage to other areas. The boxes can also be removed by walking on a switch tile. These two different systems with map boxes is now used as small puzzles across the world.
[*]  New maps and shops added to all islands.
[*]  All item requirements have been increased by the same percentage as the difference between 3 stat points per level and 5 stat points.
[*]  All resources hit decreased to 1, except for trees that are 3 hits. And fishing that is 75% chance to catch each time.
[*]  Right clicking a player will show a menu, so that you can quickly invite another player to a party, guild etc.
[*]  Can no longer cast spells through blocked objects such as walls and trees.
[*]  Normal movement speed has been increased by 9%.
[*]  Tons of items have been changed so that they focus on for example 1 skill. So that you can more choose what you prefer, instead of having marginal overall gains.
[*]  Running has been removed, but normal walking speed is as mentioned above 9% faster. Using the running key now will instead imitate an attack animation.
[*]  The skill Splash AOE effect is now set to 1 tile around the player.
[*]  Arrows travel 15% faster.
[*]  4 new trap types added (all with new graphics), for example huge fire, fast spinning trap, larger area traps etc..
[*]  New chest type added for island 6.
[*]  Spells Buffs can now be stacked, meaning you can have multiple spells that give you AC, as long as its a different spell providing it.
[*]  Spells can now give skill points.
[*]  Spells can now give multiple buffs, meaning a spell can give both HP and Damage for example.
[*]  Spells can now have a cooldown, meaning you can only cast it 1 time every X seconds.
[*]  Spell window now displays the hotkey of the spell and the current cooldown countdown.
[*]  Spell target area Chess has been replaced with AOE and/or Cross.
[*]  All wall spells now hits 3 times instead of 2 times.
[*]  All mage leggings has now been converted to gear for all players that instead require endurance and some wisdom. This is to further make it so that mages put points into endurance to get proper armor gears and so that paladins can easier utilize these leggings as well.
[*]  All belts now require endurance. 
[*]  Sneak converted to a new skill called Aura.
[*]  Lifesteal rebalanced to: REQ: 15 Strength. You have a 11% chance to lifesteal and you get +0.5% (spells get half of that) of your max health per point spent. Enemies hit by the skill splash has 5% chance to lifesteal. Minimum amount of lifesteal is 2.
[*]  Allround skill has been slightly rebalanced.
[*]  Daily rewards have been boosted.
[*]  Monster spawn times have overall been lowered.
[*]  Monsters will no longer attack you if you can not see them. Meaning they will only attack you if they are visible on your screen.
[*]  Many new monster graphics has been added.
[*]  All chests have been given good rare loot.
[*]  New environment graphics added.
[*]  Maps have received new puzzles based on the new box system and weather effects.
[*]  Minimum pvp damage formula has been tweaked to provide more base damage.
[*]  Resources for crafting has been changed. 
[*]  The skill untwine has been buffed and now gives +0.2AC/point.
[*]  New character screen no longer allows you to distribute your starting stats. All characters starts with 10 in each stat.
[*]  Gathering resources now requires 2 stamina each hit.
[*]  Rare item drops (with random boosts) can now give Bonus Damage (which boost dmg for all attacks), Damage Reduction (total damage taken is reduced by a percentage) and damage increase in percentage.
[*]  Increased chance for rare items to appear from monster drops.
[*]  Rare items can now give an extra bonus stat. Also increased chance to give skills on items and can no longer give any of the resource gathering skills on items.
[*]  Star Monsters have been given a lot more EXP.
[*]  Star monsters have increased chance to drop emeralds. It's now 30% extra chance per star instead of 10% per star.
[*]  A monsters max damage has been rebalanced to 45% of the players max hp. So if the player has 200 Max Health. Then a monster can not do more than 90 pure damage each attack.
[*]  Damage from star monsters has been slightly lowered to make them even more attractive.
[*]  The last two armors can now only be bought on island 5.
[*]  Some rebalancing of monster density in island 1-3.
[*]  Monsters drop all new Prime items.
[*]  Minimum damage on monsters rebalanced.
[*]  You can now pay for the clues to enter i5 town castle.
[*]  Spells and items heavily rebalanced.
[*]  Pet exp increased so it's much more rewarding for the player.
[*]  Rings, amulets and belts have been rebalanced and given more requirements.
[*]  The amount of attacks a pet can do on a map before getting exhausted is doubled from 250 to 500.
[*]  Monster spawns have been changed on tons of areas.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/f08f5164ba36cb105b09cc2ab8e108f7e1d23e05.png[/img]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]  Fixed so firewall spells and all other spells render properly and does not move when the player moves.
[*]  Fixed issue of the target area showing the wrong target colors for the object it hovered.
[*]  Fixed an issue with having too much experience.
[*]  Fixed an issue where player graphics on the left side of the screen floated to the right when on the edge.
[*]  Fixed an issue that could result in server list not working.
[*]  Fixed so spells render the proper time they was supposed to.
[*]  Fixed an issue with very quick map swapping.
[*]  Fixed entangle issue.
[*]  Fixed an issue related to npc's that can spawn other npcs.
[*]  Fixed an issue with arrows.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/1e89cb0b01b0226edc841d6bad240de77d8cd9d2.png[/img]

[list]
[*]  THE REAPER: A new very hard/impossible boss has been added.
[*]  Added support for Chinese translations in the game.
[*]  The whos online list will now show players from the other servers as well, and show what server they play on.
[*]  New mouse target area graphics.
[*]  Target area now has an opacity effect.
[*]  Servers will be removed from the server list after 4 days of inactivity.
[*]  Graphics improved.
[*]  Ingame data list updated with new resource information.
[*]  Bosses will now have a red star rendered on them if they are a boss, just like star monsters have 1-3 yellow stars on them.
[*]  All battle notifications are scrolled up much more fluently.
[*]  The new eternal item set can be purchased on island 5.
[*]  Makes the monster darker when you hover above it with the mouse to indicate targeting.
[*]  The casting aim cursor will turn gray if the casting is out of range or if a blocked tile is found in the path.
[*]  Monsters within the spell cursor aim will fade to slightly darker to indicate they are within the target area.
[*]  You can hover the buttons above the chat and it will show what the button is for.
[*]  Buffed spells on a player will persist when logging out and retain it's duration when logging back in.
[*]  Online player count is no longer shown for each server.
[*]  Now showing if players are online on a server instead of the count.
[*]  Game startup speed optimized.
[*]  You can now right click active buffs to see the name of the buff.
[*]  Spell animations will grow larger by each level.
[*]  A new spell type has been added. This spell type removes all aggro you have on yourself.
[*]  Right click a player to view some player info and the players achievements.
[*]  Increased security to protect against hacking.
[*]  The spell description window has been made larger.
[*]  You can now double tap a hotkey and cast the spell on yourself.
[*]  New spell list ingame.
[*]  Data list now shows what maps each spell is sold on.
[*]  Increased hacking protection.
[*]  A delete and show all spells button has been added to the hotbar for spells/abilities.
[*]  Improved spell deselection.
[*]  Converted all texts in client to localized texts for all languages supported.
[*]  All languages have gotten more text translated.
[*]  Spells can now be deleted from your hotbar.
[*]  First Aid can be bought in the first town.
[*]  Buffed stats are now shown on the stats screen.
[*]  Holding shift will perform an attack animation while walking. It wont do any damage. Its just for having fun.
[*]  Stat points, skills points and housing points available to spend will be displayed in blue text.
[*]  Server selection screen optimized.
[*]  General improvements to the game.
[*]  A message will be shown if you are level 1 and use the shift button telling you that the real attack button is CTRL or left Mouse Button.
[*]  Maps can now control the spawn time of monsters. So the same monsters on different maps can have different spawn times. This will not be shown in monster spawn time. So it is something that will be noticed and utilized to make certain maps packed with monsters but with longer spawn times.
[*]  All maps have been converted to handle the new resource system.
[*]  Better information about gathering provided to player when trying to gather and has lack of skill points.
[*]  A new sound effect has been added each time a ring or amulet drops from a monster.
[*]  Improved feedback from buttons in the inventory tabs.
[*]  Spells casted by monsters will be rendered in a much more redish color to distinguise them from player spells.
[*]  The datalist showing all the items have been heavily improved.
[*]  You can now create a party from the popup menu when right clicking yourself or another player.
[*]  Improved handling of incoming data on server select page.
[*]  Rare items dropped by monsters with random stats was previously named +0 in the end. They are now named Rare instead. And updates on those items will show as Rare +1 etc..
[*]  Unidentified items exist and will be shown with blue text in the inventory. Identified items will show with green text.
[*]  NPC added to first town to skin items.
[*]  Improved server selection load time upon server lag.
[*]  Items in the player market older than 30days will be discounted by 75%. So an item costing 1000gold will be 250gold.
[*]  You can now search for items in your chest.
[*]  A new EU server has been setup.
[*]  The ingame data list will now show which monsters are bosses.
[*]  Item in your inventory will now have a colored background if they are unidentified or rare.
[*]  Data list has been updated with all the needed info to compensate for the stat changes, monsters etc..
[*]  You can now see the image of the item you selected in your chest.
[*]  You can now see the image of the item you selected in the player market.
[*]  Island 1,2 and 3 has received weather effects on some maps.
[*]  New maps added for island 3 with a new boss.
[*]  New area added to island 1.
[*]  Exp the player gets from pet attacks are now visually displayed above the character each pet attack.
[*]  When a lightning strike occurs, a sound will play.
[*]  Tutorial has been updated with all the new info/balancing.
[*]  Lots of work on localizations (different languages).
[*]  You can now type !events in the chat to see all running events, and !help to see all available commands.
[*]  Changes to a lot of maps.
[*]  New functions for certain in game moderators.
[*]  A countdown has been added to the server selection page that will show when the new update goes live and servers come online.
[*]  Optimized login with a significant time.
[*]  Cleanup rendering loops.
[*]  These are the new area level requirements for access to the different islands:
[list]
[*] Island 1: lvl 1-20
[*] Island 2: lvl 20-35
[*] Island 3: lvl 35-50
[*] Island 4: lvl 50-65
[*] Island 5: lvl 65+
[*] Island 6: lvl 80+
[/list][/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #21: Player Hosted Servers
notes.content:
[h1][b]Support for player hosted servers![/b][/h1]

Everybody can now, for free, host and control their own 2D MMORPG server. You get the power to completely remake the game if you so wish.
Have you always wanted to run your own server? Well now it's as easy as it can be. The server download comes with a full guide on how to get it all setup and running. If you have any issues you can reach out on Steam or to the community and you will get help.

The [b]download [/b]is available on the official website: https://key2heaven.com/downloads.html

[h2][b]How does it work?[/b][/h2]
When you start the game the first page is a server selection page. This page holds all the official servers and all the player hosted servers. When you have setup your server correctly it will be automatically be added onto that list for other players to join. You provide a description for your server that is shown on that page and are able to advertise that specific server to bring in new players. The server list will show the server with the most online players at the top.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/3334377084ae920d8819da108d5b8366e56b14cb.png[/img]

[h2][b]What can I change?[/b][/h2]
First of there are some settings that you can begin by deciding on. These can be changed at any time.
* Server Type: PVP or PVE
* Exp Rate: Default value is 1, but you can set it to 4 and then all players on the server will get 4 times as much experience.

[b]The server also comes[/b] with it's own C# scripting language and a big guide that explains it all to get you started. It is completely optional if you want to make your own scripts or not, it is not a requirement. You have the power to make new quests, fun events, only your imagination holds you back. You can script events that are triggered on tiles or create more complex structures by also utilizing scripts on events triggered by the player. Here are some examle events:
* OnJoinGame
* OnLeaveGame
* OnUseItem
* OnDropItem
* OnPlayerAttackPlayer
* And many more..

[b]You can also change[/b] all the ingame content. With change I mean you can make new, edit existing or remove. So you have full access. Here are the different content you can change:
* Maps
* Items
* Monsters/NPCs
* Spells
* Arrows
* Shops

[b]Over time[/b] we will improve and allow further customizations for the servers. So do not hesitate if you have any feedback or if there is something more you want added!

[h2][b]Other Changes:[/b][/h2]
* All official servers will run with x2 EXP for all players regardless of level until further notice.
* The ingame boost for players below level 65 is removed due to it now being global instead.
* Hosted servers will not have ingame purchases. It's up to the server owner to host events to give out global exp potions.
* Completely remade the server selection screen.
* The Brazil server has been removed. There will now be 2 official servers only, one for PVE and one for PVP. It cost too much money for me to run the BR server. Hopefully someone else can host one now. Although it would be on a different realm of course.
* Fixed so the blue text when maxing a skill reset if you no longer has above it.
* Some skills effects are displayed in smaller fonts above their targets.
* New data to the formula list about pvp damage balancing.
* The spell boost text on the screen now have different colors to easier indicate what is active.
* Updates some localizations.
* Increased server security.

notes.content:
[b]Highlights[/b]
* A new raid has been added to the i5 Forest area.
* 4 new skills added: Accuracy, Dodge, Exhaustion and RadicalHeal.
* A one time skill reset for all characters has been added. Can be done from a NPC on the starting map on island 1 (just below the temple).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/81bf189fe5b3c9f272bfd0591c3257d19149f6a1.png[/img]

[b]Skills[/b]
* The skill Deathblock has been reworked to heal you for 50% and give +5 Max HP per point!
* The skill Sneak now gives +5 Max Stamina per point.
* The skill Allround now gives your pet the number of points in Allround divided by 2 as exp each hit the pet does.
* The skill Untwine now gives +2 max stamina per point.
* The skill Snare now works for all different types of attacks. Including spells.
* The skill Poison now works for all different types of attacks. Including spells.
* The skill Double Damage now works for all different types of attacks. Including spells.
* The skill Lifesteal now works for spells but gives 0.3% HP instead of 0.6% HP.
* Some skill requirements have been reduced to make it easier for mages to get them.
* A help menu added to the skills tab so you can easily see what skills are class restricted. But pretty much all skills now work for all players.
* Parry rebalanced.
* The skill LootFinder has been boosted to provide increase chance of getting unique skills applied to +0 items.
* Rebalanced resistance so that it blocks 0.8DMG per point instead of 1 and increased the max points in it from 6 to 10.
* Increased double hit from max 5 points to max 10 points.
* Skill trueshot has been adjusted to 10 points and 2% chance per point.
* Skill petpower boosted with: "If the pet gets the killing blow, you get +1Gold/point."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650512/a79fc8d0ebdbd8e6ebfe3739351c1d5ab021a2a8.png[/img]

[b]Fixes[/b]
* Fixed so debless and entangle from monsters has unique spell icons on the screen.
* Fixed so spells deselect correctly.
* Fixed so item can not break when removing all upgrades from it.
* Fixed spell icon showing the wrong image when time left is below 1minute.
* Fixed so Reputation saves correctly.
* Fixed resistance as it said it blocks 1dmg per point from monsters but it was actually 0.5.

[b]Balancing[/b]
* When you cast a heal spell on someone else. It will also heal yourself.
* I5 colloseum has been boosted with more EXP.
* You can now upgrade all belts and offhand items.
* Some item stats have been changed.
* Removing upgrades from an item can no longer fail.
* Adjusted prices in i5 shops.
* The i5 raid that costs 2emeralds/entry now costs 1 emerald instead.
* i5 boss Mayhem now gives more exp.
* Rebalanced/boosted a lot of pets.
* Assassin weapons now gives some AC and have slightly lower dmg.
* Rebalanced some monsters and items.
* Lowered price on break prevention.
* A player now has 80% chance to hit another monster/player when attacking. (affected by new skill).
* Made it easier to get the first key to enter Island 2.
* Adjusted some spell target areas and ranges.

[b]Improvements[/b]
* Right clicking the screen with a spell selected will deselect it.
* Now displaying a short text near the spell buff icons so you know more what they do.
* Will now clear map items from a map no players has been on after 12 hours instead of 90minutes.
* Added a pot shop and healing area in i3 "town/harbour".
* Added some basic info about +0 items to the flag menu.
* Housing point distribution moved from the skill page to the stats page.
* 4 new skill upgrade types added since we have 4 new Skills.
* More information added to the ingame formula list under the flag menu.
* Improved spellicons gfx.

notes.title: Dev Log #18: Tournaments and so much more!
notes.content:
[b]New & Improvements:[/b]
* Several more adventurous quest parts added.
* i5 water area, the area to the east with Precious and other tree monsters has been rebalanced because it was way too hard to get to the boss.
* i5 monster exp has been greatly increased.
* i5 Colosseum will now give monsters random hp, damage and experience within  a increasing line instead of always following the same static line.
* Star monsters now give +25% EXP.
* Star monster damage is changed to give +20% damage per star.
* Primordial Ice Staff now gives +2 Allround instead of +2 Untwine.
* Bosses will spawn monsters 25% less.
* Some monsters on i4 has increased EXP.
* Chance for monsters casting global DMG is reduced.
* EXP on i2, i3 monsters increased.
* All capes now have 2 max upgrades set on them and they all give skills.
* All quivers now have max upgrade level set to 1.
* Rebalanced "a lot" of monsters in the game with boosted exp and such.
* i4 monsters/bosses drop items more frequently.
* Increased the exp from spawning monsters on i5 from quests.
* i5 Raids boosted with exp and rebalanced.
* Lowered minimum damage on i5 monsters.
* You can now turn a normal item into a +0 item from the upgrade item system. Costs 50k gold. The upgrade to +0 behaves as other upgrades with a 50% success rate and it can not break.
* All monsters will spawn within a 20% difference from their spawntime. A monster with 100sec spawntime, will spawn anytime between 100sec and 120 sec.
* You can no longer sell equipped items. (So people dont do it by mistake)
* You can no longer add equipped items to the player market. (So people dont do it by mistake)
* Updated PVP/PVE tutorial.
* !roll command in chat is now also displayed in the chat.
* Healing spells will no longer deselect after a cast. (Only first aid will deselect)
* Added transparency to all spell targets.
* Added a small transparency to spells and we will feel it out to see if it stays.
* Party EXP info is added to the ingame party menu.
* Updated info on the ingame Tutorial so it says the correct EXP loss on PVE death. It is 5% of the current exp gained on the level you are on. Previously said 10%.
* Further improved on the upgrade item chance formula.
* Items dropped in PVE death are now written out in your chat.
* Changed "putting items stats into your chat text" key from SHIFT to CTRL so that it does not interrupt you when you run and browse your inventory.
* The text above the chat will now display even if you cross maps.
* When you die from a monster, it will now show the monster name and its last damage done to you in your chat.
* All treasures received from digging with the spade is boosted.
* Taunt will work on randomly walking monsters.
* A auto range for monsters have been added so they can not be abused.
* Monsters have a slightly longer delay before attacking you when you transition maps.
* All monster sight range on aggressive monsters have been lowered by 20%.
* Monsters have been attacking too quickly, once every 800ms. Fixed so they now attack once every 1sec.
* Random walk monsters will now random walk 50% of the time and behave normally the other 50%.
* Total exp gained is now displayed on the stats menu.
* i5 colosseum now requires level 70 instead of level 80.
* The global damage done by monsters will now only be casted on you if you are within 14 tiles of the monster. (no longer the entire map)
* Monsters will cast Dispell less frequently.
* Ingame level TopList/TopList Harcore will now sort by level and exp, instead of seraph and level. So a high-level char can become top 1 without being x3 seraph. If two players are the same level, it will show the one with the most exp at the top.
* Renaming Max Upgrade Level to Safe Upgrade Level.
* Increased chance for +0 items to give skills.
* Some items buffed.
* You can now hold SHIFT+rightclick on the spell hotbar to remove a spell from it. Information about this also added to the ingame formula list.
* The global dmg spell casted by monsters on you now has a sound effect.
* Adjusted color of some skills that's rendered above when triggered.
* Monsters can no longer teleport away while taunted.
* Showing spell icons instead of showing the text for buffs.
* Buffed the random spawn monster on i5 so it can include a wider range of monsters/bosses (including i5 monsters).
* Lowered cost of upgrading an item with a skill (using tokens).
* You can now dye capes.
* Grand Stamina Potion now gives +100 stamina instead of +75.
* "Haste" spell has been boosted.
* You can now have the data list open with monsters, items etc while walking with WSAD without it scrolling in the lists..
